title: Henselian SNC neighborhoods with universal residual cover
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic a positive prime $p$. Let $Y$ be a regular separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-regular-scheme], and let $D=\bigcup_{a\in A}D_a$ be a reduced strict normal crossings boundary with finitely many components [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Fix $I\subseteq A$, put $Y_I=Y\setminus\bigcup_{a\notin I}D_a$, and give $S=(\bigcap_{i\in I}D_i)\cap Y_I$ its reduced structure. Empty intersections mean $Y$. There is an affine etale covering of $S$ by charts $V=\operatorname{Spec}B\to Y_I$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] on which the $D_i$ have global equations $t_i$; at every point where several $t_i$ vanish they are part of a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]. Write $J=(t_i)_{i\in I}$. The charts can be chosen with $S_V=\operatorname{Spec}(B/J)$ nonempty and connected, and each $V$ regular, Noetherian and separated.

For each chart there is an affine ind-etale map $u:U=\operatorname{Spec}H\to V$ [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] with $S_U=\operatorname{Spec}(H/JH)$ nonempty and connected and a pro-etale covering $S_U\to S_V$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. More precisely, $S_U$ is the inverse limit of the pointed connected finite etale Galois covers of $S_V$ in [lem-sfb-pointed-finite-etale-limit-cover], and $(H,JH)$ is a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. The construction is obtained by henselizing $(B,J)$ and taking the filtered colimit of the finite etale algebras lifting this pointed cover system. There are compatible primitive roots $\zeta_n\in H$ for all $n>0$ prime to $p$, with $\zeta_m^{m/n}=\zeta_n$ for $n\mid m$ and $\zeta_n^a-\zeta_n^b$ a unit for distinct residues $a,b$ modulo $n$.

Put $H_n=H[x_i\mid i\in I]/(x_i^n-t_i)_{i\in I}$, $H_\infty=\varinjlim_nH_n$ with the power transitions, $U^\circ=\operatorname{Spec}H[1/\prod_i t_i]$, $T=\operatorname{Spec}H_\infty$, and $T^\circ=\operatorname{Spec}H_\infty[1/\prod_i t_i]$. All $U,U^\circ,\operatorname{Spec}H_n,T,T^\circ$ are nonempty connected qcqs schemes. The finite and full parameter-root algebras over any strictly henselian regular Noetherian local ring of characteristic $p$ with a partial regular parameter system also have nonempty connected spectra and nonempty connected punctured spectra. Every $\operatorname{Spec}H_n[1/\prod_i t_i]\to U^\circ$ and every divisibility transition on these punctured levels is finite etale and surjective. Their inverse limit is a pro-etale covering $T^\circ\to U^\circ$. The family $S_U\to S$ covers $S$. The empty stratum has the empty family. These constructions admit common pointed refinements and compatible pullback maps of the displayed rings and root systems. For $I=\varnothing$, $H_n=H_\infty=H$, $S_V=V$, and $U\to V$ is its pointed universal finite-etale limit cover.
